what: pytorch_model.bin of who-r-u0000/0000000000000000000000000000000000000, the second nullifAI repository, built the same way as SF-D-2026-0010.

evidence.basis: ReversingLabs lists who-r-u0000/0000000000000000000000000000000000000 among the malicious Hugging Face repositories of the nullifAI campaign (and prints SHA-1 values, which the feed cannot use). The repository is disabled and unchanged since 2024-05-05, before the report, and holds one pickle-bearing file; this is the LFS object id the Hub API lists for it, tied to the listed blob id by the pointer check.

source.title: Malicious ML models discovered on Hugging Face platform
